stateSemantics.LEGAL_CLEAR: Bounded owner product direction adopted only. Supported pre-adjudication branch may be implemented; all source, completeness, independent review, raster and native integration controls remain. No counsel/packet/production grant.

decisions.bindingProductRule: Use Act 691 of 2025 and current A.C.A. §§ 16-90-1601 and 16-90-1602 as controlling dismissal/sealing authority. Repealed § 16-101-106 is not current law. Retain exact July 27, 2021 ACIC petition/order source artifacts and printed citations unchanged. Participant guide and source receipt must disclose the pre-Act-691 edition and identify § 16-90-1602 as governing authority. Do not use old § 16-98-303 as current veterans-court eligibility authority. Use the held pair only for deferred proceedings without an entered judgment of guilt followed by successful veterans-treatment-court completion. Broader Arkansas program settings do not establish these forms as post-adjudication instruments. If post-adjudication and the pair does not fit, stop generated-form branch and provide supported handoff; do not deny substantive relief because the instrument is unidentified. Require evidence of successful specialty-court completion before dismissal/sealing. Prosecuting attorney recommendation for dismissal and sealing is a required statutory condition. The specialty-court judge owns consideration of past criminal history and determination that dismissal and sealing are appropriate. Never precheck, prefill, attest to or manufacture those findings; old rehabilitation checkbox is not a participant fact. Implement § 16-90-1602(d) conditionally: circuit specialty judge may address another circuit court conviction; district specialty judge may address another district court conviction. Require successful program completion, completion of the other court sentence, other court agreement that sealing is appropriate, and other court signature on the ACIC uniform sealing order. Old target-group checkbox, obsolete exclusion list and generic concurrence language do not substitute for these conditions. Other-court and judge-owned execution fields remain blank until appropriate court actor completes them. Under § 16-90-1602(b)-(c), the specialty-court judge may enter sealing immediately upon successful completion; this is not a guaranteed order. Ordinary § 16-90-1406(c)(1) numerical prior-felony limit does not apply, without eliminating other statutory requirements. DWI/BWI stays blocked until applicable § 5-65-111 lookback has elapsed. Apply current § 16-90-1413 through § 16-90-1602(b): serve prosecuting attorney for county where petition filed; serve arresting agency only if named party; service due within 3 days after filing. Prosecuting attorney has 30 days after receipt or filing, whichever later, to oppose. Participant does not handle post-order agency distribution. Clerk sends statutory certified-order distribution to prosecuting attorney, arresting agency, ACIC and applicable district court. Reconcile inconsistent old form recipients/timing in participant instructions while retaining printed source text as evidence. Uniform sealing-petition filing fee is $0 under current § 16-90-1419. Do not generate a fee-waiver application solely for this no-fee petition. Keep specialty-court program user fees, treatment/testing/supervision costs, public-defender/other program charges, and fines/restitution/court costs/other-case obligations separate. Program cost is not sealing-petition filing fee. Stage 1 remains distinct from post-completion sealing. Use current Arkansas Judiciary Veterans Treatment Court criteria, not ACIC petition alone. Require available program records supporting adult participant; criminal charge/case; veteran or qualifying service-member status; qualifying mental-health or substance-use disorder; required clinical/risk assessment treatment; team admission/approval; ultimately successful completion. Do not manufacture clinical findings, risk classifications, team approval or completion. Stage 2 begins only with supported necessary completion facts. Keep exact held ACIC petition/order hashes; do not reacquire for stale citations or edit source bytes. Put visible current-law reconciliation in governed instructions/metadata for review. Participant-entered fields only from collected facts. Prosecutor, court, judge, recommendation, approval, signature, finding and order-entry fields remain protected unless appropriate actor supplies them. Owner product-design questions are resolved; this is not packet PASS, raster PASS, counsel approval or production authority. Implement bounded changes; run saved-byte/component/branch checks; require independent semantic review; freeze current packet bytes; current-byte raster and original-page independent review; native integration and preservation checks. Do not reopen resolved Act691/service/fee questions without contrary current authority. Participant-specific post-adjudication handoff does not hold supported pre-adjudication family in research.
